---
title: "Opcional: pseudobulk de mNbML2 en los clústeres 7 y 8"
author: "Noemi Gomez"
date: "07 de noviembre de 2026"
output: html_document
---

```{r instalar_paquetes, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install(c("scRNAseq", "DESeq2"))
```

```{r librerias}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scRNAseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r cargar_datos}
load("../output/clase1_clustering.RData")
obj$Mouse <- as.character(sce$Mouse[match(colnames(obj), colnames(sce))])
```

```{r cargar_referencia}
# Misma referencia y anotación que en clase2_brain.Rmd
sce_ref <- LaMannoBrainData("mouse-embryo", ensembl = FALSE, location = FALSE)
sce_ref <- sce_ref[, !is.na(sce_ref$Cell_type)]
rownames(sce_ref) <- make.unique(rownames(sce_ref))
referencia <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as(assay(sce_ref, "counts"), "dgCMatrix"),
                                 project = "LaManno")
referencia$cell_type <- as.character(sce_ref$Cell_type)
```

```{r preparar_referencia}
referencia <- NormalizeData(referencia, verbose = FALSE)
referencia <- FindVariableFeatures(referencia, verbose = FALSE)
referencia <- ScaleData(referencia, verbose = FALSE)
referencia <- RunPCA(referencia, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r anotar_celulas}
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = referencia, query = obj,
                                reference.reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)
pred <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = referencia$cell_type, dims = 1:20)
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, metadata = pred)
obj$cell_type <- obj$predicted.id
```

```{r composicion_clusters}
obj_78 <- subset(obj, subset = seurat_clusters %in% c("7", "8"))
obj_78$cluster <- paste0("C", obj_78$seurat_clusters)
table(obj_78$Mouse, obj_78$cluster)
comp <- obj_78[[]] %>%
  count(Mouse, cluster, cell_type, name = "n_celulas") %>%
  group_by(Mouse, cluster) %>%
  mutate(proporcion = n_celulas / sum(n_celulas)) %>%
  ungroup()
comp %>% group_by(Mouse, cluster) %>% slice_max(n_celulas, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r barras_composicion, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
ggplot(comp, aes(cluster, proporcion, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col() + facet_wrap(~ Mouse, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(x = "Clúster", y = "Proporción celular", fill = "Tipo predicho") + theme_classic()
```

```{r seleccionar_tipo_celular}
tipo <- "mNbML2"
obj_tipo <- subset(obj_78, subset = cell_type == tipo)
table(obj_tipo$Mouse, obj_tipo$cluster)
```

```{r generar_pseudobulk}
pseudo <- AggregateExpression(obj_tipo, assays = "RNA", group.by = c("Mouse", "cluster"),
                              return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA
meta_pb <- obj_tipo[[]] %>% count(Mouse, cluster, name = "n_cells")
rownames(meta_pb) <- paste(meta_pb$Mouse, meta_pb$cluster, sep = "_")
meta_pb <- meta_pb[colnames(pseudo), ]
meta_pb
dim(pseudo)
as.matrix(pseudo[1:10, ])
```

```{r seleccionar_perfiles}
# Umbral editable; no dividir células para crear réplicas artificiales
min_celulas <- 20
coldata <- subset(meta_pb, n_cells >= min_celulas)
tab <- table(coldata$Mouse, factor(coldata$cluster, levels = c("C7", "C8")))
tab
ratones <- rownames(tab)[rowSums(tab > 0) == 2]
coldata <- coldata[coldata$Mouse %in% ratones, ]
coldata$Mouse <- factor(coldata$Mouse)
coldata$cluster <- factor(coldata$cluster, levels = c("C7", "C8"))
cat("Ratones con ambos perfiles tras el filtro:", length(ratones), "\n")
coldata
```

```{r normalizar_pseudobulk}
if (length(ratones) == 0) stop("Ningún ratón conserva ambos clústeres; revisar min_celulas y meta_pb.")
counts_pb <- as.matrix(pseudo[, rownames(coldata), drop = FALSE])
diseno <- if (length(ratones) >= 2) ~ Mouse + cluster else ~ cluster
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_pb, colData = coldata, design = diseno)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 20, ]
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts")
normalizados <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
```

```{r cambios_descriptivos}
# Comparación C8 / C7 dentro de cada ratón; después, media entre ratones
log2FC_por_raton <- log2(normalizados[, paste0(ratones, "_C8"), drop = FALSE] + 0.5) -
  log2(normalizados[, paste0(ratones, "_C7"), drop = FALSE] + 0.5)
colnames(log2FC_por_raton) <- paste0("log2FC_", ratones)
res_descriptivo <- data.frame(gene = rownames(dds),
                              log2FoldChange = rowMeans(log2FC_por_raton), log2FC_por_raton)
res_descriptivo <- res_descriptivo[order(abs(res_descriptivo$log2FoldChange), decreasing = TRUE), ]
head(res_descriptivo, 20)
```

```{r barras_log2fc, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
top_genes <- head(res_descriptivo, 15)
ggplot(top_genes, aes(reorder(gene, log2FoldChange), log2FoldChange,
                     fill = log2FoldChange > 0)) +
  geom_col() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"),
                    breaks = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Mayor en C7", "Mayor en C8")) +
  labs(x = "Gen", y = "log2FC descriptivo (C8 / C7)", fill = NULL) + theme_classic()
```

```{r expresion_diferencial}
# Dos ratones pareados permiten un ajuste exploratorio; no hay un mínimo rígido de tres.
# Los clústeres se definieron con estos mismos datos: los p-valores son exploratorios.
res_de <- NULL
if (length(ratones) >= 2) {
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res_de <- as.data.frame(results(dds, contrast = c("cluster", "C8", "C7"), alpha = 0.05)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")
  res_de <- res_de[order(res_de$padj), ]
  head(res_de, 20)
} else {
  cat("Solo queda un ratón pareado: se muestran log2FC descriptivos, sin p-valores ni p ajustados.")
}
```

```{r volcano, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(res_de)) {
  volcano <- res_de %>% filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    mutate(grupo = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 2 ~ "Mayor en C8",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -2 ~ "Mayor en C7",
      TRUE ~ "No significativo"
    ))
  ggplot(volcano, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)), color = grupo)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Mayor en C7" = "#377EB8", "Mayor en C8" = "#E41A1C",
                                  "No significativo" = "grey75")) +
    labs(x = "log2FC (C8 / C7)", y = "-log10(p ajustado)", color = NULL) + theme_classic()
}
```

```{r guardar_resultados}
dir.create("../output/opcional4", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save(comp, tipo, pseudo, meta_pb, min_celulas, coldata, ratones, dds,
     res_descriptivo, res_de, file = "../output/opcional4/brain_clusters7_8.RData", compress = "xz")
```
